Initial release of greenhelix-nhi-security-agents.

- Comprehensive guide for securing non-human identities (NHI) in AI agent deployments.
- Covers NHI lifecycle management, credential rotation, workload identity federation, and machine-to-machine authentication patterns.
- Includes integration guidance for Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit and zero-trust architectures for AI agents.
- Details compliance frameworks relevant to the $7.4B NHI market.
- Provides actionable, production-ready Python code examples.
- Tailored for organizations using AI agent fleets and Openclaw-compatible systems.
